```{r import_data}
fread("Mosaic_positional_concordance_norm.site_summary.tsv") -> site_summary

head(site_summary)
```

```{r calculate_rates, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# 1. Per-site mismatch rates per founder
# ============================================================

founders <- LETTERS[1:8]  # A through H

mismatch_counts_to_qual <- function(mismatch, callable) {
  fifelse(
    callable <= 0,
    NA_real_,
    fifelse(
      mismatch <= 0,
      Inf,
      -10 * log10(mismatch / callable)
    )
  )
}

# Calculate mismatch rate = mismatch / expected for each founder
# Guard against division by zero with fifelse
for (f in founders) {
  exp_col <- paste0("expected_", f)
  mis_col <- paste0("mismatch_", f)
  rate_col <- paste0("rate_", f)
  qual_col <- paste0("qual_", f)

  site_summary[, (rate_col) := fifelse(get(exp_col) == 0, NA_real_, get(mis_col) / get(exp_col))]
  site_summary[, (qual_col) := mismatch_counts_to_qual(get(mis_col), get(exp_col))]
}

# Overall site-level mismatch rate
site_summary[, rate_overall := fifelse(
  expected_total_alleles == 0,
  NA_real_,
  mismatch_total_alleles / expected_total_alleles
)]

site_summary[, qual_overall := mismatch_counts_to_qual(mismatch_total_alleles, expected_total_alleles)]

# ============================================================
# 2. Reshape to long format for plotting
# ============================================================

# --- Long format: mismatch rates per founder per site ---
rate_cols <- paste0("rate_", founders)

site_rates_long <- melt(
  site_summary,
  id.vars       = c("chrom", "start", "end"),
  measure.vars  = rate_cols,
  variable.name = "founder",
  value.name    = "mismatch_rate"
)
site_rates_long[, founder := gsub("rate_", "", founder)]

# --- Long format: raw counts (expected + mismatch) ---
expected_long <- melt(
  site_summary,
  id.vars       = c("chrom", "start", "end"),
  measure.vars  = paste0("expected_", founders),
  variable.name = "founder",
  value.name    = "expected"
)[, founder := gsub("expected_", "", founder)]

mismatch_long <- melt(
  site_summary,
  id.vars       = c("chrom", "start", "end"),
  measure.vars  = paste0("mismatch_", founders),
  variable.name = "founder",
  value.name    = "mismatch"
)[, founder := gsub("mismatch_", "", founder)]

counts_long <- merge(expected_long, mismatch_long, by = c("chrom", "start", "end", "founder"))
counts_long[, mismatch_rate := fifelse(expected == 0, NA_real_, mismatch / expected)]
counts_long[, mismatch_qual := mismatch_counts_to_qual(mismatch, expected)]


# ============================================================
# 3. Summarize mismatch patterns across chromosomes
# ============================================================

# Per-chromosome, per-founder: total expected, total mismatch, aggregate rate
chrom_founder_summary <- counts_long[,
  .(total_expected  = sum(expected, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mismatch  = sum(mismatch, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites         = .N),
  by = .(chrom, founder)
]
chrom_founder_summary[, agg_rate := fifelse(
  total_expected == 0,
  NA_real_,
  total_mismatch / total_expected
)]
chrom_founder_summary[, agg_qual := mismatch_counts_to_qual(total_mismatch, total_expected)]

# Per-chromosome overall
chrom_summary <- site_summary[,
  .(total_expected  = sum(expected_total_alleles, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mismatch  = sum(mismatch_total_alleles, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites         = .N,
    mean_rate       = mean(rate_overall, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rate     = median(rate_overall, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = chrom
]
chrom_summary[, agg_rate := fifelse(
  total_expected == 0,
  NA_real_,
  total_mismatch / total_expected
)]
chrom_summary[, agg_qual := mismatch_counts_to_qual(total_mismatch, total_expected)]

# Order chromosomes naturally
chrom_order <- c(paste0("chr", 1:19), "chrX", "chrY", "chrM")
chrom_summary[, chrom := factor(chrom, levels = chrom_order)]
chrom_founder_summary[, chrom := factor(chrom, levels = chrom_order)]
```

```{r summarize_by_chromosome, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
# ============================================================
# 4. Plots
# ============================================================

# plot total number of mismatch sites per chromosome
p_nsite_chrom <- ggplot(chrom_summary[!is.na(chrom)], aes(x = chrom, y = n_sites/1e6)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of sites", title = "Number of sites\nper chromosome (millions)") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

# --- Plot A: Aggregate mismatch rate by chromosome ---
p_chrom <- ggplot(chrom_summary[!is.na(chrom)], aes(x = chrom, y = agg_qual)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mismatch QUAL", title = "Aggregate mismatch\nQUAL by chromosome") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

# --- Plot B: Mismatch rate by founder across chromosomes (heatmap) ---
p_heat <- ggplot(chrom_founder_summary[!is.na(chrom)],
                 aes(x = founder, y = chrom, fill = agg_qual)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90", name = "Mismatch\nQUAL") +
  labs(x = "Founder", y = NULL, title = "Mismatch QUAL\nby chromosome & founder") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

# --- Plot C: Distribution of per-site mismatch rates by founder ---
p_founder_dist <- ggplot(site_rates_long[!is.na(mismatch_rate) & mismatch_rate > 0],
                         aes(x = founder, y = mismatch_rate)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey85", scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Founder", y = "Per-site mismatch rate",
       title = "Distribution of mismatch rates\nby founder (sites with >0 mismatch)") +
  theme_cowplot()

# --- Plot D: Number of mismatching animals per site (histogram) ---
p_n_mismatch <- ggplot(site_summary, aes(x = n_mismatch_animals)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Number of mismatching animals", y = "Number of sites (M)",
       title = "Distribution of discordant\nanimals per site") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(scale = 1e-6), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.8)

p_nsite_chrom
p_chrom
p_heat
p_founder_dist
p_n_mismatch

```

```{r mismatch_vs_expected, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ggplot(chrom_founder_summary, aes(x=total_mismatch/1e3, y=total_expected/1e3, color=founder)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x="Total mismatches (thousands)", y="Total expected (thousands)", title="Mismatch vs expected\nby chromosome & founder") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color="black")

```

```{r mismatch_rate_vs_expected, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=3.5}
# ============================================================
# Per-site mismatch rate vs. expected allele count
# ============================================================

# --- Plot: Rate vs. expected, per founder ---
# Does mismatch fraction become noisy/inflated as expected
# count drops?

# --- Hexbin version if you have too many points ---
p_hex <- ggplot(
  counts_long[!is.na(mismatch_rate) & expected > 0],
  aes(x = expected, y = mismatch_rate)
) +
  geom_hex(bins = 20) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", name = "Sites", option="magma", begin=0.9, end=0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~founder, nrow = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Expected allele count at site",
    y = "Mismatch rate",
    title = "Per-site mismatch rate vs. expected (density)"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
  # set background to grey to better see empty bins
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"))

p_hex
```

```{r identify_high_mismatch_sites, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
# Sites that are incorrect at least 5% of the time

Mismatch_Threshold <- 0.05

High_Mismatch_Sites <- site_summary[
  expected_total_alleles > 0 &
  !is.na(rate_overall) &
  rate_overall >= Mismatch_Threshold
][order(-rate_overall, -mismatch_total_alleles, chrom, start)]

High_Mismatch_Sites
nrow(High_Mismatch_Sites)

ggplot(
  High_Mismatch_Sites,
  aes(x = rate_overall)
) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Sites with mismatch rate >= 5%",
    x = "Mismatch rate",
    y = "Number of sites"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))
```

```{r write_bad_positions_file}
Mismatch_Threshold <- 0.05

Bad_Positions <- site_summary[
  expected_total_alleles > 0 &
  !is.na(rate_overall) &
  rate_overall >= Mismatch_Threshold,
  .(
    chrom,
    start,
    end,
    expected_total_alleles,
    mismatch_total_alleles,
    mismatch_rate = rate_overall,
    mismatch_qual = qual_overall,
    n_mismatch_animals,
    n_missing_sample,
    n_missing_both,
    n_missing_founder
  )
][order(chrom, start, end)]

fwrite(
  Bad_Positions,
  "Mosaic_positional_concordance_norm.bad_positions_mismatch_ge_5pct.tsv",
  sep = "\t"
)

Bad_Positions
nrow(Bad_Positions)
```
